title: Object Reference Schema
description: A pointer to an object. OBJECT_REF is never the object itself (ALIAS != IDENTITY). subkind 'alias' adds a stable name, owner, and resolution history.

id.description: Stable identifier of this reference record itself.

subkind.description: Optional. When present and equal to 'alias', additional fields become required.

target_id.description: The identifier of the object being referenced. Must not be treated as identity of the referent.

target_type.description: Optional declared type of the target (principal, assertion, etc.).

status.description: Lifecycle / authority status drawn from the closed enum.

alias.description: Human-meaningful name when subkind is alias.

alias_type.description: Classification of the alias (e.g. short-name, external-id).

resolution_history.description: Ordered history of prior resolutions (for audit).

resolved.description: Advisory flag indicating whether the target was successfully resolved in a given context.
